<h2 id="一taskfactory也能手搓">一、TaskFactory也能手搓</h2>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>是的TaskFactory也能手搓</li>
<li>而且效果是杠杠的</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="二现在继续说程序优化的事情">二、现在继续说程序优化的事情</h2>
<h3 id="1-话说产品经理小马给工程师小牛提了需求批量获取产品详情">1. 话说产品经理小马给工程师小牛提了需求批量获取产品详情</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>小牛三下五除二就干上线了</li>
<li>代码那是写的干净又漂亮,没有一行多余的代码</li>
<li>只是性能有一点点瑕疵</li>
<li>每个商品获取要0.1秒,获取10个就是1秒多</li>
<li>小马说: 我看博客园有个博主说了,不要在循环里面直接await</li>
<li>小牛说: 是吗?转发我看一下</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">_output.WriteLine($"begin {DateTime.Now:HH:mm:ss.fff}");
Stopwatch sw = Stopwatch.StartNew();
List&lt;Product&gt; products = new(10);
for (int i = 0; i &lt; 10; i++)
{
    var id = i;
    var item = await GetProductAsync(id);
    products.Add(item);
}
sw.Stop();
_output.WriteLine($"end {DateTime.Now:HH:mm:ss.fff}, Elapsed {sw.ElapsedMilliseconds}");
// begin 09:10:06.086
// end 09:10:07.206, Elapsed 1118


private const int _concurrentLimit = 6;
private readonly ConcurrentControl _control = new();
private readonly ITestOutputHelper _output = output;
internal async Task&lt;Product&gt; GetProductAsync(int id)
{
    _control.Increment();
    await Task.Delay(100);
    var concurrent = _control.Count;
    _control.Decrement();
    if (concurrent &gt; _concurrentLimit)
    {
        throw new Exception("Server is busy!!!");
    }
    return new(id);
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="2-小牛说so-easy稍等">2. 小牛说so easy,稍等</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>小牛立马悟了</li>
<li>马上把代码优化了</li>
<li>可是一上线程序就挂了</li>
<li>由于上游允许的最高并发是6,10个并发把上游给打挂了</li>
<li>小牛说: 小马你坑惨我了呀</li>
<li>小牛立马私信来骂那个博客园博主</li>
<li>对笔者就是那个博主</li>
<li>自己挖的坑终归是要填的,为此只好给小牛安利手搓TaskFactory</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">_output.WriteLine($"begin {DateTime.Now:HH:mm:ss.fff}");
Stopwatch sw = Stopwatch.StartNew();
List&lt;Task&lt;Product&gt;&gt; tasks = new(10);
for (int i = 0; i &lt; 10; i++)
{
    var id = i;
    var task = GetProductAsync(id);
    tasks.Add(task);
}
var products = await Task.WhenAll(tasks);
sw.Stop();
_output.WriteLine($"end {DateTime.Now:HH:mm:ss.fff}, Elapsed {sw.ElapsedMilliseconds}");

// begin 09:22:05.622
// System.Exception : Server is busy!!!
</code></pre>
<h3 id="3-用手搓taskfactory来优化">3. 用手搓TaskFactory来优化</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>ConcurrentTaskFactory就是手搓的TaskFactory</li>
<li>ConcurrencyLevel设置为6</li>
<li>使用StartTask发起异步请求</li>
<li>其他代码都不变</li>
<li>耗时不到0.3秒,比原来快了3倍多</li>
<li>http服务是天生的多线程</li>
<li>即使你单线程调用数据库,在大量抓取的情况下,数据库也会被打挂</li>
<li>不知道大家有没有打挂过自家数据库的经历</li>
<li>用上《手搓》TaskFactory,可以对上游做到并发可控,程序改动还极小</li>
<li>小牛看得那是目瞪口呆,这是怎么实现的</li>
<li>小牛说: 快教教我</li>
<li>笔者说: 没问题,我写篇博文你看了自然就明白了</li>
<li>于是这篇文章诞生了</li>
<li>话说博客园也偶发数据库被打挂的情况</li>
<li>不知道Dudu会不会看到这篇文章</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var options = new ReduceOptions { ConcurrencyLevel = 6 };
var factory = new ConcurrentTaskFactory(options);
_output.WriteLine($"begin {DateTime.Now:HH:mm:ss.fff}");
Stopwatch sw = Stopwatch.StartNew();
List&lt;Task&lt;Product&gt;&gt; tasks = new(10);
for (int i = 0; i &lt; 10; i++)
{
    var id = i;
    var task = factory.StartTask(() =&gt; GetProductAsync(id));
    tasks.Add(task);
}
var products = await Task.WhenAll(tasks);
sw.Stop();
_output.WriteLine($"end {DateTime.Now:HH:mm:ss.fff}, Elapsed {sw.ElapsedMilliseconds}");
// begin 09:33:03.070
// end 09:33:03.370, Elapsed 299
</code></pre>
<h2 id="三-揭秘手搓taskfactory">三、 揭秘《手搓》TaskFactory</h2>
<h3 id="1-单并发异步操作">1. 单并发异步操作</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>ConcurrencyLevel设置为1</li>
<li>异步调用10次</li>
<li>虽然执行异步的线程ID不止一个</li>
<li>实际执行每0.1秒执行一次</li>
<li>也就是等上一次执行完才开始下一次</li>
<li>现在谁还敢说异步线程不是乖宝宝!!!</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var options = new ReduceOptions { ConcurrencyLevel = 1 };
var factory = new ConcurrentTaskFactory(options);
List&lt;Task&lt;Product&gt;&gt; tasks = new(10);
for (int i = 0; i &lt; 10; i++)
{
    var id = i;
    var task = factory.StartTask(() =&gt; GetProductAsync(id));
    tasks.Add(task);
}
var products = await Task.WhenAll(tasks);
Assert.NotNull(products);
Assert.Equal(10, products.Length);

internal async Task&lt;Product&gt; GetProductAsync(int id)
{
    _control.Increment();
    await Task.Delay(100);
    var concurrent = _control.Count;
    _control.Decrement();
    if (concurrent &gt; _concurrentLimit)
    {
        throw new Exception("Server is busy!!!");
    }
    _output.WriteLine($"Thread{Environment.CurrentManagedThreadId} GetProductAsync({id}),{DateTime.Now:HH:mm:ss.fff}");
    return new(id);
}

// Thread10 GetProductAsync(0),10:04:37.009
// Thread11 GetProductAsync(1),10:04:37.135
// Thread32 GetProductAsync(2),10:04:37.263
// Thread11 GetProductAsync(3),10:04:37.391
// Thread32 GetProductAsync(4),10:04:37.518
// Thread11 GetProductAsync(5),10:04:37.646
// Thread11 GetProductAsync(6),10:04:37.774
// Thread11 GetProductAsync(7),10:04:37.902
// Thread11 GetProductAsync(8),10:04:38.030
// Thread11 GetProductAsync(9),10:04:38.158
</code></pre>
<h3 id="2-并发测试">2. 并发测试</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>ConcurrencyLevel设置为4</li>
<li>异步调用100次</li>
<li>总耗时3秒</li>
<li>4个并发清晰可见</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var options = new ReduceOptions { ConcurrencyLevel = 4 };
var factory = new ConcurrentTaskFactory(options);
_output.WriteLine($"begin {DateTime.Now:HH:mm:ss.fff}");
Stopwatch sw = Stopwatch.StartNew();
List&lt;Task&lt;Product&gt;&gt; tasks = new(100);
for (int i = 0; i &lt; 100; i++)
{
    var id = i;
    var task = factory.StartTask(() =&gt; GetProductAsync(id));
    tasks.Add(task);
}
var products = await Task.WhenAll(tasks);
sw.Stop();
_output.WriteLine($"end {DateTime.Now:HH:mm:ss.fff}, Elapsed {sw.ElapsedMilliseconds}");
Assert.NotNull(products);
Assert.Equal(100, products.Length);

// begin 10:20:45.317

<h3 id="3-手搓taskfactory异步排队原理">3. 《手搓》TaskFactory异步排队原理</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>《手搓》TaskFactory控制住了异步的开始和结束</li>
<li>当发起异步请求后,该线程并不在《手搓》TaskFactory的线程池中</li>
<li>为了控制并发,也扣除并发配额</li>
<li>并在注册ContinueWith中返还并发配额</li>
<li>控制住了异步的开始和结束,就相当于异步线程也在《手搓》TaskFactory的线程池中运行</li>
<li>配额不够,后面的异步线程就不会触发</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="四总结">四、总结</h2>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>《手搓》TaskFactory里面内置了线程池</li>
<li>应该定义为静态的字段或属性</li>
<li>也可以注册到容器中为单例对象</li>
<li>可以对每个数据库或其他上游资源分别建一个实例,用来控制并发</li>
<li>这样就可以放心大胆的使用并发</li>
<li>程序性能开始起飞</li>
<li>同时程序的安全性也得到了坚实的保障</li>
<li>涉及IO异步操作线程池可以设大一点,只要不会打挂上游就行</li>
<li>IO异步线程和普通线程不一样,不会太影响CPU</li>
<li>同步和异步IO的线程最好不要混用,影响配额的准确配置</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
